quests.name: Chapter 4: A Tail Tale
objectives: Enter the Gloommeadow .
Explore the Gloommeadow with Winnie the Pooh .
There's Eeyore ! Go talk to him.
Search the dried-up riverbed in the Gloommeadow for Eeyore's Tail , or a substitail instead.

There's a pile of debris blocking the river!
  ‧ Talk to Eeyore about it.

Gather materials to craft a new home for the hedgehogs :
  ‧ Hardwood. (6) Juniper Berry. (5) White & Pink Foxglove. (2) Soft Limestone. (6)
Craft the Hedgehog Companion Home .
Place the new Hedgehog Companion Home in the Gloommeadow .

Feed a hedgehog some Fruit or Golden Honey .
  ‧ Hedgehogs may be shy, so be patient if they curl up and hide.
Talk to Eeyore about your progress.
Use your Pickaxe to remove the pile of debris from the river in the Gloommeadow .
Talk to Eeyore about what you saw in the river.
Fish out the items that are floating in the river. (2)
Make sure you have Cuckoo Clock Tail in your Inventory.
Bring the first substitail, the Cuckoo Clock Tail , to Eeyore .
Take a picture of Eeyore and his new tail.
Make sure you have Steel Spring Tail in your Inventory.
Show Eeyore the picture you took.
Take a picture of Eeyore and his newer tail.
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about Eeyore's substitail situation.
Talk to Pooh about the item he found.
Follow Pooh to where he found a potential substitail.
Dig up the object that Winnie the Pooh found.
Make sure you have Umbrella Tail in your Inventory.
Bring the Umbrella Tail to Eeyore .
Take a picture of Eeyore and his newest tail.
Ask Eeyore if he approves of the Umbrella Tail .
Follow Winnie the Pooh to the bridge in the Gloommeadow with Eeyore .
Interact with the bridge in the Gloommeadow to play Pooh Sticks .

Fish for Eeyore's Tail .
  ‧ It came out from under the bridge.
Make sure you have Eeyore's Tail in your Inventory.
Bring the Eeyore's Tail to Eeyore .

quests.name: Chapter 5: The Big Red Monster
objectives: Talk to Eeyore to find out what else might be going wrong in the Gloommeadow .

Gather materials to craft a Storybook Sword and Heroic Helmet :
  ‧ Hardwood. (4) Tree Resin. (10) Soft Limestone. (10) Rose & Cream Foxglove. (3) Driftwood. (5) Honey Agate. (2) Sweet Chestnut. (8)

Craft your new equipment:
  ‧ Storybook Sword. Heroic Helmet.

Dress up in your new gear:
  ‧ Storybook Sword. Heroic Helmet.
Talk to Eeyore and show him that you're dressed for an adventure.
Talk to Eeyore to continue your adventure.
Follow Eeyore to the edge of the fog.
Approach the fog and pick up what you find .
That Fog Dust reminded you of something. Talk to Eeyore about it.

Gather materials to cook a Fog-Busting Potion :
  ‧ Juniper Berry. Golden Pattypan. Plush Fish. Truffle.
Cook the Fog-Busting Potion .
Make sure you have Fog-Busting Potion in your Inventory.
Show the Fog-Busting Potion to Eeyore to continue on your knightly quest.
Use the Fog-Busting Potion in your Inventory.
Water the lantern with your Royal Watering Can . (1)
Search for the Big Red Monster with Winnie the Pooh .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh to discuss the Big Red Monster .
Meet with Winnie the Pooh near (but not too near) the Big Red Monster.
Use your Royal Shovel to break the branches around the Big Red Monster . (6)
Pick up the defeated Big Red Monster .
Open the clothing pouch in your Inventory.
Dress up in the Big Red Pajamas .
Return to Eeyore to discuss your victory over the Big Red Monster .

quests.name: Chapter 6: A Place for Eeyore
objectives: Talk to Eeyore about how things are going in the Gloommeadow .

Gather materials to craft a Amber Brushwoods Upgrade for your Pickaxe .
  ‧ Juniper Berry. (4) Acorn Snail. (2) Honey Agate. (1)
Craft a Amber Brushwoods Upgrade for your Pickaxe .
Use the Amber Brushwoods Upgrade in your Inventory.
Smash the chunks of Amber Brushwoods around what's left of Eeyore's House. (8)
Check in with Eeyore before you begin construction.

Gather materials to fix Eeyore's House :
  ‧ Driftwood. (10) Tree Resin. (5) Oak Leaves. (3) Soft Limestone. (12)
Use the materials you gathered on Eeyore's House to repair it.
Ask Eeyore if he needs anything else.
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about a gift for Eeyore .

Gather materials to decorate around Eeyore's House :
  ‧ Golden Honey. (6) Honey Agate. (4) Acorn Snail. (2) Driftwood. (4)

Craft decorations for the space around Eeyore's House :
  ‧ Acorn Lantern. (2) Driftwood Paths. (16)

Decorate around Eeyore's House :
  ‧ Acorn Lantern. (2) Driftwood Paths. (16)
Talk to Eeyore about the decorating you've done.
Take a picture of Winnie the Pooh and Eeyore next to Eeyore's House .
Welcome Eeyore to the Honeyglow Woods .
Check in with Eeyore .

quests.name: Interlude 2: The Gloomy Hollow
objectives: Return to the Gloommeadow .
Interact with the Art-full Place next to the Everoak Tree entrance.

Another door into the Everoak Tree opened!
  ‧ Enter the Everoak Tree from the Gloommeadow.
Explore this hollow space inside the Everoak Tree.
Check the note next to the alcove.
Talk to Eeyore about what can be found in the hollow of the Tree.

Find the Broken Honeypot Pieces in the Everoak Tree and craft them together to make:
  ‧ Repaired Sun-Glow Honeypot.
Place the Repaired Sun-Glow Honeypot in the alcove.
Talk to Eeyore about what to do next.

Solve the puzzle on the ground.
  ‧ Use your Royal Shovel to change the tiles until they all make the right picture.

Something colorful popped out of the puzzle!
  ‧ Pick up the Primary Colors Potion.
Make sure you have Primary Colors Potion in your Inventory.
Bring the Primary Colors Potion to Eeyore .
Use the Primary Colors Potion in your Inventory.
Use your Royal Watering Can to restore some color to the gray honeypots. (7)
That worked, somewhat. Talk to Eeyore about your colorful progress.
Solve the puzzle on the ground to re-color the honeypots.

A part of the puzzle is missing:
  ‧ Find the Missing Puzzle Tile in the Everoak Tree.
Return the Missing Puzzle Tile to the puzzle.

Solve the new puzzle.
  ‧ Use your Royal Shovel to change the tiles until they all make the right picture.

Something new and differently colored has popped out of the puzzle:
  ‧ Pick up the Secondary Colors Potion.
Use the Secondary Colors Potion in your Inventory.
Water the gray honeypots to restore even more colors. (3)
That's much more colorful! Talk to Eeyore about your success.
Water the Repaired Sun-Glow Honeypot in the alcove.

All the honeypots are colorful now, and a Memory appeared! Pick it up.
  ‧ Interact with the Memory in the Everoak Tree.
Talk to Eeyore about what you found.
Leave the Everoak Tree and return to the Gloommeadow .
The fog is lifting, showing a new path forward.
The fog has lifted! Talk to Eeyore about what to do next.
Follow Eeyore to the entrance to Braveheart Grove .
Clear the Corrupted Honey Wall to reach Braveheart Grove .
(Optional) Restore the Scrooge's Store Tree .
(Optional) Help Eeyore by completing his first Friendship Quest .
(Optional) Play Pooh Sticks .
